reviews.title: Great timer, however…
reviews.text: I wrote the programmer a couple times, pleading that he make it easier to pause a timer, and harder to accidentally stop it.  I suggested that the pause button simply be bigger.   Ignoring my point, he made the pause button smaller for a long while, and recently restored it to the original too-small size.  Baffling!

reviews.title: Does what it needs to
reviews.text: I paid for the premium version a few years ago. Worth every penny. I also love an app that you can just buy instead of needing a subscription. It's a few bucks and I use it all the time. Sometimes I use it for interval running or timed exercises, but I use it every single exercise day for my cooldown stretches. It's customizable and easy to use. Definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Best Timer I’ve Used

I love the added intuitive features for setting sounds and alarms vs timers.  I love having one place for my remover alarms/timers vs some in my phone, watch, etc.

reviews.title: Version 3.2 of Repeat Timer Pro broke or removed the “Start at” button
reviews.text:
I am dismayed that the “Start At” button has disappeared from the ordinary Repeating  timer feature (not the new alarms). Unaware that the app had been updated, I spent several frustrating hours last week trying to figure out why the app was suddenly behaving differently and why UI elements had mysteriously changed.

I greatly relied on the Start At feature. I hope that a future update will be released soon to restore this crucial feature, at least for paid subscribers like myself.

I see no way to revert to a previous version unfortunately.

reviews.title: Decent app, recent update isn’t great
reviews.text:
The app works decently (so long as you spend money to get the feature that’s used in its name….kinda scummy). The most recent update however removed the ability to set what time one of the timers starts at, but it kept that functionality. So now I have a timer that will only start at 1am that I cannot change. Also the new alarm feature just does not work. I had it set up and it did not send a single notification.

Kinda annoying to have something you paid a decent chunk of money for be removed.

reviews.title: Repeat Timer
reviews.text:
I bought this app specifically for a timer feature that appeared to be available. After paying, I discovered that the functionality I wanted required an additional $4.99 purchase. That wasn’t clear to me before I bought the app, and I felt misled.
The app itself may work fine, but I think potential buyers should know that purchasing the app may not include all of the features they expect based on the description. I ended up using my iPhone’s built-in timer instead.
I would have appreciated much clearer disclosure before purchasing.

reviews.title: Very Helpful
reviews.text:
This is the best repeating interval timer I have found. Simple to set up. Great for timed cooking where you have to flip or add at the halfway point or more frequently. Especially useful with my smoker/indirect grill. 
Before I retired I would use it at work for all kinds of things where I wanted to check out processes or progress at regular intervals. 
The only on in my book is the limited number of different timers you can save.

reviews.title: Good for memory problems
reviews.text: This is a great way for people with memory problems to be reminded that they are cooking or  they’re washing clothes. It’s nice to be able to set a 20 minute timer and know that if I get sidetracked or completely forget, that I’ll be reminded again continuously until that chore is done.  I just wish it was simpler.  Great for people with mild dementia.
